before.t: 孩童和成人的免疫狀態不同、行為模式也不同，所以嬰幼兒有一些不同於成人的健康風險，如果計畫與嬰幼兒一同出國，尤其預計前往開發中國家者，建議提早諮詢旅遊醫學門診。
before.e: Children and adults differ in immune status and behaviour, so infants and young children face some health risks that adults do not. If you plan to travel abroad with an infant or young child, especially to a developing country, we recommend consulting a travel medicine clinic early.
before.ke: Consulting a travel medicine clinic is recommended

before.t: 嬰幼兒使用藥物有些特別限制，有些藥品有使用年齡下限、有些則需減少使用量，使用任何藥物前都應先諮詢醫師、藥師，或仔細閱讀藥品說明書。
before.e: There are special restrictions on medicines for infants and young children: some medicines have a minimum age, and others need a reduced dose. Before using any medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist, or read the package leaflet carefully.

before.t: 嬰幼兒是腸胃道傳染病高風險群，感染腸胃道疾病也比較容造成脫水，除了旅途中特別留意孩童的飲食安全，洗手、沖洗奶嘴、奶瓶、安撫玩具都應使用飲用水外，建議家長可以準備口服電解質補充液(oral rehydration solution, ORS)粉末，以備不時之需。
before.k: 特別留意腸胃道傳染病風險
before.e: Infants and young children are at high risk of gastrointestinal infections and become dehydrated more easily. Take particular care with the child's food and drink safety, and use drinking water to wash hands and to rinse pacifiers, feeding bottles and comfort toys. Parents are also recommended to bring oral rehydration solution (ORS) powder in case it is needed.
before.ke: Take special care with gastrointestinal infection risks

before.t: 一般而言，第二孕期間(18~24週)，孕婦狀況較穩定、較適合出國，其餘孕期則建議暫緩出國計畫，建議孕婦行前和原產科醫師討論出國計畫，並確認符合航空公司之適航規定。
before.k: 行前諮詢原主治醫師、確認健康狀況
before.e: In general, the second trimester (weeks 18–24) is when a pregnant woman's condition is more stable and she is better suited to travel abroad; we recommend postponing travel plans during the other stages of pregnancy. Pregnant women are recommended to discuss their travel plans with their regular obstetrician before departure and to confirm that they meet the airline's fitness-to-fly requirements.
before.ke: Consult your regular doctor and confirm your health before travelling

before.t: 有些疾病(如瘧疾、德國麻疹)會在孕婦身上造成特別嚴重的症狀，甚至導致死胎、畸胎，如果當地有流行疫情，且沒有適合且有效的預防措施可選擇時，建議暫緩或變更旅程。
before.e: Some diseases (such as malaria and rubella) can cause especially severe illness in pregnant women, and may even lead to stillbirth or birth defects. If there is an outbreak in the destination and no suitable, effective preventive measures are available, we recommend postponing or changing the trip.

before.t: 孕婦在預防接種、用藥上有較多的禁忌，前往旅遊醫學門診時，請告知醫師目前的懷孕狀況，以利進行正確的風險評估。
before.k: 留意預防接種及用藥安全
before.e: Pregnancy brings more contraindications for vaccination and medicines. When you visit a travel medicine clinic, tell the doctor about your current pregnancy so that the risk can be assessed correctly.

before.t: 慢性病患者應在出發前確定目前健康狀態穩定，疾病受到良好控制，以免旅遊造成健康狀況惡化。出發前建議請原主治醫師開立英文病歷摘要及藥歷，除了當作攜帶藥物的證明文件，萬一在國外需緊急就醫，也較能讓當地醫師了解病況、藥物使用狀況。
before.k: 行前諮詢原主治醫師、確認健康狀況
before.e: People with chronic illness should make sure before departure that their health is currently stable and their condition is well controlled, so that travel does not make it worse. Before departure, we recommend asking your regular doctor for an English summary of your medical record and medication history. As well as serving as proof for the medicines you carry, it will help local doctors understand your condition and medication use if you need urgent medical care abroad.
before.ke: Consult your regular doctor and confirm your health before travelling

before.t: 糖尿病患者如果旅行國家與臺灣時差超過3小時，可和醫師討論如何調整藥物使用劑量及時間；需注射胰島素，應留意藥劑的保存溫度，當地氣溫如果超過藥品建議保存的溫度範圍，建議攜帶適當防凍或保冷裝置。
before.e: If a person with diabetes travels to a country with a time difference of more than 3 hours from Taiwan, they can discuss with their doctor how to adjust the dose and timing of medicines. Those who inject insulin should pay attention to storage temperature; if the local temperature goes beyond the storage temperature range recommended for the medicine, we recommend carrying suitable anti-freezing or cooling equipment.

before.t: 有些藥物會和瘧疾預防用藥、高山症預防藥物產生交互作用，如您目前有服用其他藥物，請告知醫師。
before.e: Some medicines interact with malaria prevention medicine or altitude sickness prevention medicine. If you are taking other medicines at present, tell your doctor.

before.t: 平常有固定服用藥物者，應攜帶足量藥物(並多帶2~3天份)，最好能準備2倍份量藥物，分別存放在隨身行李及托運行李中(胰島素則不建議託運)，以免行李遺失。持慢性病連續處方箋者，如出國超過1個月，可憑機票等證明文件預領下個月的藥物。
before.e: People who regularly take medicines should carry enough (plus 2–3 days' extra), ideally twice the amount needed, stored separately in carry-on and checked baggage (insulin is not recommended for checked baggage) in case baggage is lost. People with a continuous prescription for chronic illness who go abroad for more than 1 month can collect the next month's medicines in advance by showing documents such as their air ticket.

before.t: 不論因為生病、治療或服藥造成免疫力不全，患者都應在旅遊前確定目前疾病受到穩定控制，建議先和原主治醫師討論出國計畫。
before.k: 行前諮詢原主治醫師、確認健康狀況
before.e: Whether weak immunity is caused by illness, treatment or medicines, patients should make sure before travelling that their condition is currently under stable control, and we recommend first discussing the travel plan with their regular doctor.
before.ke: Consult your regular doctor and confirm your health before travelling

before.t: 免疫力不全者感染傳染病的風險較高，也較容易出現嚴重症狀，出發前應格外留意當地是否有特殊流行疫情，尤其計畫前往開發中國家者，強烈建議先至旅遊醫學門診諮詢。旅途中應採取適當的傳染病的預防措施，例如預防蚊蟲叮咬、注意飲食安全等。
before.e: People with weakened immunity are at higher risk of infectious diseases and more likely to develop severe symptoms. Before departure, take extra care to check whether there is any special outbreak at the destination; if you plan to go to a developing country, we strongly recommend consulting a travel medicine clinic first. During the trip, take suitable measures against infectious diseases, such as preventing insect bites and paying attention to food and drink safety.

before.t: 免疫力低下者接種疫苗有些限制，有些活性疫苗則禁止接種，諮詢旅遊醫學門診時，應告知醫師您目前的健康狀況，並可考慮提供最近一次的驗血報告，如果您不希望透露病史，建議先諮詢原主治醫師。有些藥物會和瘧疾預防用藥、高山症預防藥物產生交互作用，如您目前有服用其他藥物，請告知醫師。
before.k: 留意預防接種及用藥安全
before.e: People with weakened immunity face some restrictions on vaccination, and some live vaccines must not be given. When consulting a travel medicine clinic, tell the doctor about your current health condition, and you may consider providing your most recent blood test report. If you do not wish to disclose your medical history, we recommend consulting your regular doctor first. Some medicines interact with malaria prevention medicine or altitude sickness prevention medicine. If you are taking other medicines at present, tell your doctor.

before.t: 平常有固定服用藥物者，應攜帶足量藥物(並多帶2~3天份)，最好能準備2倍份量藥物，分別存放在隨身行李及托運行李中，以免行李遺失。持慢性病連續處方箋者，如出國超過1個月，可憑機票等證明文件預領下個月的藥物。
before.e: People who regularly take medicines should carry enough (plus 2–3 days' extra), ideally twice the amount needed, stored separately in carry-on and checked baggage in case baggage is lost. People with a continuous prescription for chronic illness who go abroad for more than 1 month can collect the next month's medicines in advance by showing documents such as their air ticket.

before.t: 因旅客為在當地停留的時間，較一般觀光、短期商務行程更長，傳染病風險也隨之增加，行前請務必檢視當地傳染病風險及預防建議，並建議提早諮詢旅遊醫學門診。
before.e: Because travellers stay at the destination longer than on ordinary tourist or short business trips, the risk of infectious diseases also increases. Before departure, be sure to review the local infectious disease risks and prevention advice, and we recommend consulting a travel medicine clinic early.

before.t: 除非熟悉當地就醫流程及醫療體系，否則建議出發前提早至少1個月進行基本健康檢查(含牙科檢查)，平時如有規律服藥者，建議在藥品保存期限許可的前提下，攜帶足夠份量之藥品。
before.k: 行前確認健康狀況、準備藥品
before.e: Unless you are familiar with the local medical procedures and health care system, we recommend having a basic health check-up (including a dental check) at least 1 month before departure. If you take medicines regularly, we recommend carrying enough, as far as the shelf life of the medicines allows.
before.ke: Confirm your health and prepare medicines before travelling

before.t: 部份國家針對就學、就業等長期居留旅客有額外規定，除非國內無法取得疫苗或無法提供相關檢驗服務，或當地要求必須於入境後進行檢查，否則建議先於國內完成。
before.k: 留意特殊預防接種或健康檢查規定
before.e: Some countries have extra requirements for long-term residents such as students and workers. Unless the vaccine is unavailable in Taiwan, the relevant testing services cannot be provided, or the destination requires the check to be done after entry, we recommend completing them in Taiwan first.
before.ke: Note special vaccination or health check requirements

before.t: 海外志工、救援工作者所暴露的健康風險和一般旅客完全不同，風險型態也會隨著在當地從事的工作內容、當地受災程度、災害類別有很大的變化，但一般而言風險高於其他旅客。
before.e: The health risks faced by overseas volunteers and relief workers are completely different from those of ordinary travellers. The type of risk varies greatly with the work done there, the extent of the disaster and the type of disaster, but in general the risk is higher than for other travellers.

before.t: 因當地醫療資源可能較為缺乏，孕婦、有較嚴重潛在健康問題等很可能需要醫療照護者，不建議前往。
before.e: Because local medical resources may be scarce, travel is not recommended for pregnant women and for people with more serious underlying health problems who are likely to need medical care.

before.t: 務必提早諮詢旅遊醫學門診，並務必確認完成所有的常規預防接種。從事臨床醫療相關工作者，行前應諮詢相關的職業暴露風險，並與醫師討論是否需採取額外的傳染病預防措施。
before.e: Be sure to consult a travel medicine clinic early, and be sure to confirm that all routine vaccinations are complete. Those working in clinical care should, before departure, seek advice on occupational exposure risks and discuss with a doctor whether extra measures to prevent infectious diseases are needed.
before.ke: Consulting a travel medicine clinic is recommended

before.t: 如果接到出勤通知和實際出發日常常間隔不滿1週者，建議平時先完成較通用性的預防接種(如破傷風疫苗、A型肝炎疫苗等)。因接種黃熱病疫苗後，保護時效長，有高度機會前往非洲、南美洲等地區出勤者，可考慮評估接種。
before.k: 機動性出勤人員預防接種建議
before.e: If the interval between the deployment notice and the actual departure date is often less than 1 week, we recommend completing the more widely useful vaccinations in advance (such as the tetanus vaccine and hepatitis A vaccine). Because protection lasts a long time after yellow fever vaccination, those who are highly likely to be deployed to places such as Africa and South America may consider being assessed for vaccination.

before.t: 每個國家的健康風險都不太一樣，出發前請先充份了解當地的旅遊安全概況，做好相關行前準備：
before.e: Health risks differ from country to country. Before departure, first get a full understanding of the local travel safety situation and make the relevant preparations:

before.t: 了解當地旅遊安全及傳染病風險概況
before.e: Learn about local travel safety and infectious disease risks

before.t: 請參考本署網站提供的傳染病資訊及預防建議，其他旅遊安全資訊請參考外交部領事事務局網站「旅外安全資訊」專區。由於當地狀況可能隨時變化，出發前，請務必再次確認最新的「旅遊疫情建議等級」及外交部的「國外旅遊警示分級」資訊。
before.e: Please refer to the infectious disease information and prevention advice on the Taiwan CDC website; for other travel safety information, please refer to the "Overseas Safety Information" section of the website of the Bureau of Consular Affairs (BOCA), Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Because local conditions can change at any time, before departure be sure to check again the latest "Travel Health Notice level" and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' "Overseas Travel Alert levels".

before.t: 接種疫苗、準備預防藥物
before.e: Get vaccinated and prepare preventive medicines

before.t: 請檢視本次旅行是否需要接種疫苗、使用瘧疾預防藥物，詳細資訊請參閱下方「預防接種規定及建議」段落。
before.e: Please check whether this trip requires vaccination or malaria prevention medicine. For details, see the section "Vaccination requirements and recommendations" below.

before.t: 聰明打包
before.e: Pack smart

before.t: 除了一般旅遊必備物品，旅客應打造專屬的「旅遊健康包」，建議隨身攜帶口罩、乾洗手液、濕紙巾等個人衛生用品外，並可酌量攜帶常用的成藥及外傷護理用品，如果當地有特殊傳染病風險，請另外視需求額外準備防蚊用品、治療藥物等防疫用品。
before.e: Besides the usual travel essentials, travellers should put together their own "travel health kit". We recommend carrying personal hygiene items such as masks, hand sanitiser and wet wipes, and you may bring a suitable amount of commonly used over-the-counter medicines and wound care supplies. If there is a special infectious disease risk at the destination, also prepare extra protective items such as insect repellent and treatment medicines as needed.

before.t: 其他準備工作
before.e: Other preparations

before.t: 海外就醫費用多半十分高昂，請視個人需求額外投保旅遊醫療保險。
before.e: Medical costs abroad are mostly very high. Take out additional travel medical insurance according to your own needs.

before.t: 自助旅行或預計長期停留當地的旅客，建議先查詢當地的就醫資訊。
before.e: Travellers on independent trips, or planning to stay at the destination for a long time, are recommended to look up local medical information first.

vaccines.t: 大部分疫苗接種後需要2週才會產生足夠保護力，有些疫苗需要間隔一段時間再接種第2劑、甚至第3劑，瘧疾預防藥品也需要在抵達疫區前就開始服用，建議旅客行前2至4週至旅遊醫學門診，諮詢醫師相關建議。
vaccines.e: Most vaccines take 2 weeks after vaccination to give enough protection, and some vaccines need a second or even third dose after an interval. Malaria prevention medicine also has to be started before arriving in the affected area. We recommend that travellers visit a travel medicine clinic 2 to 4 weeks before departure to get the doctor's advice.

diseases.t: 很多傳染病沒有有效的疫苗或預防藥物，旅途中應採取以下預防措施：
diseases.e: Many infectious diseases have no effective vaccine or preventive medicine. During the trip, take the following preventive measures:

diseases.t: (疾病流行情況可能隨時改變，以下僅舉幾項重要疾病，其他近期資訊請參考「即時疫情」)
diseases.e: (The outbreak situation of diseases may change at any time. Only a few important diseases are listed below; for other recent information, please refer to "Real-time outbreak")

diseases.t: 保持個人衛生是預防傳染病的共通原則。建議旅途中常以肥皂(或乾洗手液)洗手，尤其是用餐前、如廁後，並儘量不觸摸眼鼻口；如需長時間停留於人口密集、較不通風的室內，可考慮配戴口罩。
diseases.e: Keeping up personal hygiene is the common principle for preventing infectious diseases. During the trip, we recommend washing your hands often with soap (or hand sanitiser), especially before meals and after using the toilet, and touching your eyes, nose and mouth as little as possible. If you need to stay for a long time in a crowded, poorly ventilated indoor space, you may consider wearing a mask.
Take care with food and drink safety

diseases.t: 不吃未煮熟的食物，如：沙拉、生海鮮、半熟肉品或蛋、含生蛋或生佐料的醬汁。
diseases.e: Do not eat undercooked food, such as salad, raw seafood, half-cooked meat or eggs, and sauces containing raw egg or raw seasonings.

diseases.t: 水果建議自行清洗、去皮，避免食用已去皮切片的水果。
diseases.e: Wash fruit yourself and peel it, and avoid fruit that has been peeled and sliced already.

diseases.t: 盡量熱食(選擇現場烹調、持續加熱或點餐後再次加熱的食物)，以免食物冷卻及保存過程中滋生細菌或受蒼蠅沾染。
diseases.e: Eat hot food as far as possible (choose food cooked on the spot, kept hot, or reheated after you order), so that bacteria do not grow or flies settle on food as it cools and is stored.

diseases.t: 只飲用包裝完整的水、飲料，或確認經過煮沸的水。
diseases.e: Drink only water and drinks in intact sealed packaging, or water confirmed to have been boiled.

diseases.t: 避免食用冰品、或含冰塊飲料，除非確認是由乾淨的水源製成。
diseases.e: Avoid ice products or drinks with ice, unless you are sure they were made from a clean water source.

diseases.t: 選擇衛生條件良好的用餐地點，如規模較大的飯店、沒有蟑螂蚊蠅的餐廳。
diseases.e: Eat where hygiene is good, such as larger hotels and restaurants without cockroaches or flies.

diseases.t: 在當地應避免逗弄、餵食哺乳動物，並避免至可能有蝙蝠的洞窟，以免感染狂犬病。
diseases.e: Do not tease or feed mammals, and stay out of caves that may house bats, to avoid rabies.

during.e: What to do with suspected infectious disease symptoms

during.t: 發燒是很多傳染病的初期症狀，一般感染所引起的發燒可在48小時內緩解，如果體溫持續上升、高燒(39度以上)、合併其他皮膚出疹、頸部僵硬、意識不清等症狀，或當地有特殊警示疫情，請立即就醫診治。
during.e: Fever is an early symptom of many infectious diseases. A fever caused by an ordinary infection usually eases within 48 hours. If the body temperature keeps rising, there is a high fever (above 39 degrees), it comes with other symptoms such as a skin rash, a stiff neck or confusion, or there is a special alert for an outbreak at the destination, seek medical care immediately.

during.t: 出現腹瀉症狀時，最重要的是補充足量水分，避免飲用咖啡、酒、含高糖分飲料等容易加速脫水的飲品，一般不建議自行服用止瀉藥物。大部分腹瀉症狀會自行好轉，但如果出現脫水症狀(口乾、雙眼凹陷、皮膚乾燥無彈性)、大便帶血、腹瀉嘔吐情況非常嚴重、或持續3天以上沒有好轉，應該立刻就醫。
during.e: When you have diarrhoea, the most important thing is to drink enough fluids. Avoid drinks that speed up dehydration, such as coffee, alcohol and drinks high in sugar, and in general do not take anti-diarrhoea medicine on your own. Most diarrhoea gets better by itself, but if you show signs of dehydration (dry mouth, sunken eyes, dry skin that has lost its elasticity), blood in the stool, very severe diarrhoea and vomiting, or no improvement after 3 days or more, seek medical care immediately.

during.t: 當地的哺乳類動物(含蝙蝠)可能帶有狂犬病病毒，如遭哺乳動物抓咬受傷、或遭舔舐有傷口的皮膚，請立刻以大量肥皂水沖洗15分鐘，並馬上就醫接種狂犬病疫苗及免疫球蛋白,5年內未接種破傷風疫苗者，建議一併接種破傷風疫苗。
during.e: Mammals there (including bats) may carry the rabies virus. If a mammal scratches or bites you, or licks broken skin, immediately rinse with plenty of soapy water for 15 minutes, and seek medical care straight away to get the rabies vaccine and immunoglobulin. If you have not had a tetanus vaccine within the past 5 years, we recommend having the tetanus vaccine at the same time.
Where to call for emergency help

during.t: 如遭逢急難事故，可請國內親友協助撥打免付費「旅外國人緊急服務專線」0800-085-095(諧音『您幫我您救我』)，自國外撥打回國須自付國際電話費用，撥打方式為：(當地國國際電話冠碼)+886-800-085-095。
during.e: In an emergency, you can ask relatives and friends in Taiwan to call the toll-free "Emergency Service Hotline for Taiwanese Travelling Abroad" 0800-085-095 (a homophone for "you help me, you save me"). Calling Taiwan from abroad, you pay the international call charges yourself. Dial: (international call prefix of the country you are in)+886-800-085-095.

during.t: 疑似傳染病旅客返國時主動通報
during.e: Travellers with suspected infectious disease should report voluntarily on returning

during.t: 旅途中或返國途中如果有任何不適症狀，入境時您可諮詢疾病管制署機場檢疫櫃台，檢疫人員會給予適切的資訊及處理，以保障您及您身邊親友的健康。如果當地有特殊疫情，請務必依規定進行入境主動通報。
during.e: If you have any symptoms of illness during the trip or on the way home, you can consult the Taiwan CDC airport quarantine counter on entry, and the quarantine staff will give you suitable information and handling to protect the health of you and your family and friends. If there is a special outbreak at the destination, be sure to make a voluntary report on entry as required.

after.t: 旅遊後21天內如有不適，建議就醫評估，並告知醫師相關旅遊史，以利醫師作出正確的診斷。如果有咳嗽、喉嚨痛等呼吸道症狀，建議配戴口罩。
after.e: If you feel unwell within 21 days after travel, we recommend seeing a doctor for assessment and telling the doctor about your travel history, so that the doctor can make a correct diagnosis. If you have respiratory symptoms such as cough or sore throat, we recommend wearing a mask.

after.t: 有任何疑問，可撥打疾病管制署免付費諮詢專線1922或0800-001922洽詢(國外請撥+886-800-001922,發話端需自付跨國撥打費用)。
after.e: If you have any questions, you can call the Taiwan CDC toll-free hotline 1922 or 0800-001922 (from abroad, call +886-800-001922; the caller pays the international call charges).

lines.t: 不論是否出國，都應該完成常規疫苗的施打，出發前請確認已按時完成接種。有些例行性疫苗預防的疾病在臺灣已經很少見，但是仍然流行於其他國家，未完成、或不確定接種史的旅客，建議行前先諮詢旅遊醫學門診醫師，並視需求補打疫苗。
lines.e: Whether or not you travel abroad, you should complete your routine vaccinations; before departure, make sure they have been completed on schedule. Some diseases prevented by routine vaccines are now rare in Taiwan but are still found in other countries. Travellers who have not completed their vaccinations, or are unsure of their vaccination history, are recommended to consult a travel medicine clinic doctor before departure and to catch up on vaccines as needed.

lines.t: 幼兒在出發前，應該依年齡完成應注射的常規疫苗，假如要前往開發中國家或高風險國家，又未達接種年齡，可諮詢醫師是否能提早接種、或縮短施打間隔時間。
lines.e: Before departure, young children should complete the routine vaccines due for their age. If they are going to a developing country or high-risk country and are not yet old enough to be vaccinated, you can ask a doctor whether vaccination can be given earlier or the interval between doses shortened.

lines.t: 年滿6個月以上、未滿1歲的嬰兒，如果要前往麻疹疫區，建議自費接種1劑麻疹、德國麻疹、腮腺炎混合疫苗，自費接種相關資訊可洽所在地衛生局、所(健康中心)或旅遊醫學門診。
lines.e: Infants aged 6 months or more but under 1 year who are going to a measles-affected area are recommended to have 1 dose of the combined measles, rubella and mumps vaccine at their own expense. For information on self-paid vaccination, contact your local health bureau, health centre or travel medicine clinic.

lines.t: 免疫不全者建議評估接種肺炎鏈球菌疫苗，並每年接種流感疫苗，不符公費接種條件者可考慮自費接種。
lines.e: People with weakened immunity are recommended to be assessed for the pneumococcal vaccine and to have the influenza vaccine every year. Those who do not meet the conditions for the publicly funded vaccine may consider vaccination at their own expense.

lines.t: 造血幹細胞(如骨髓)移植者需在移植後，重新評估接種所有常規疫苗，出國前請確認已完成接種。
lines.e: People who have had a haematopoietic stem cell (such as bone marrow) transplant need to be reassessed for all routine vaccines after the transplant; before going abroad, make sure vaccination has been completed.

lines.t: 慢性疾病患者是流感重症的高危險族群，建議每年接種流感疫苗，另建議接種肺炎鏈球菌疫苗，不符公費接種條件者可考慮自費接種。
lines.e: People with chronic illness are at high risk of severe influenza, so the influenza vaccine every year is recommended, and the pneumococcal vaccine is also recommended. Those who do not meet the conditions for the publicly funded vaccine may consider vaccination at their own expense.

lines.t: 依據世界衛生組織「國際旅遊與健康—國家與地區疫苗預防接種建議列表」，該國未針對入境者提出預防接種要求。
lines.e: According to the World Health Organization (WHO) "International travel and health: vaccination requirements and recommendations by country" list, this country does not require vaccination from people entering.

lines.t: ※由於各國政府可能依當地防疫需要，即時調整入境預防接種政策，建議於出國前先洽目的國外交部或駐外館處網站，瞭解最新簽證申辦或入境需備文件規定。
lines.e: * Because governments may adjust entry vaccination policies at short notice according to local disease control needs, we recommend checking the website of the destination country's foreign ministry or Taiwan's overseas mission before travelling to learn the latest visa application or entry document requirements.

lines.t: 未滿9個月嬰兒不建議接種黃熱病疫苗，建議暫緩前往高風險國家。
lines.e: The yellow fever vaccine is not recommended for infants under 9 months; we recommend postponing travel to high-risk countries.

lines.t: 懷孕初期不建議接種黃熱病疫苗；於其他孕期間，除非經醫師評估有接種的必要性，也不建議施打黃熱病疫苗，建議孕婦儘量暫緩前往高風險區。如必須前往，請務必採取加強性的防蚊措施，假如經評估不適合接種、但當地政府要求入境旅客必須出示預防接種證明書，可請醫師開立「不適合接種證明」，但當地衛生主管機關仍可視情況採取必要的檢疫措施。
lines.e: The yellow fever vaccine is not recommended in early pregnancy; in other stages of pregnancy it is also not recommended unless a doctor assesses that vaccination is necessary, and pregnant women are recommended to postpone travel to high-risk areas as far as possible. If you must go, be sure to take extra measures against mosquito bites. If you are assessed as unsuitable for vaccination but the local government requires entering travellers to show a vaccination certificate, a doctor can issue a "certificate of unsuitability for vaccination", but the local health authority may still take the necessary quarantine measures as it sees fit.

lines.t: 黃熱病疫苗為活性疫苗，免疫不全症患者可能不適合接種，近期內曾使用免疫抑制劑、放射治療者則需要在停止治療後間隔一段時間後才能接種，請提早諮詢旅遊醫學門診。
lines.e: The yellow fever vaccine is a live vaccine and may not be suitable for people with immunodeficiency. People who have recently used immunosuppressants or had radiotherapy can be vaccinated only after an interval following the end of treatment. Consult a travel medicine clinic early.

lines.t: 如果經評估不適合接種疫苗，建議暫緩前往高風險區；如必須前往，請務必採取加強性的防蚊措施，若當地政府要求入境旅客必須出示預防接種證明書，可請醫師開立「不適合接種證明」，但當地衛生主管機關仍可視情況採取必要的檢疫措施。
lines.e: If you are assessed as unsuitable for vaccination, we recommend postponing travel to high-risk areas. If you must go, be sure to take extra measures against mosquito bites. If the local government requires entering travellers to show a vaccination certificate, a doctor can issue a "certificate of unsuitability for vaccination", but the local health authority may still take the necessary quarantine measures as it sees fit.

lines.t: 境內無感染風險，無特別預防接種之建議。
lines.e: There is no risk of infection within the country, and no special vaccination is recommended.

lines.t: 當地的飲食、飲水有傳染風險，建議旅客接種疫苗。
lines.e: Food and drink there carry a risk of infection, and travellers are recommended to be vaccinated.

lines.t: 1歲以下嬰兒目前沒有足夠的安全性、疫苗有效性資料，不適合接種A型肝炎疫苗。
lines.e: There are currently not enough data on safety and vaccine effectiveness for infants under 1 year, so the hepatitis A vaccine is not suitable for them.

lines.t: 孕婦沒有足夠的接種試驗資料，雖然不活化疫苗對胎兒理論上沒有影響，仍應由醫師評估，有接種必要性才建議施打。
lines.e: There are not enough vaccination trial data for pregnant women. Although an inactivated vaccine should in theory have no effect on the baby, a doctor should still assess it, and vaccination is recommended only if necessary.

lines.t: 建議免疫不全者接種A型肝炎疫苗。
lines.e: People with weakened immunity are recommended to have the hepatitis A vaccine.

lines.t: 當地蝙蝠、犬、貓等哺乳動物都可能帶有狂犬病病毒，依據衛生福利部傳染病防治諮詢會預防接種組(ACIP)115年第1次會議，對於有暴露狂犬病動物風險或難以取得安全的暴露後預防處置(PEP)且暴露期間≦3年之旅遊者，狂犬病暴露前預防接種(PrEP)之建議如下：
lines.e: Mammals there such as bats, dogs and cats may all carry the rabies virus. According to the 1st meeting of 2026 (ROC year 115) of the Vaccination Group of the Advisory Committee on Communicable Disease Control (ACIP), Ministry of Health and Welfare, the recommendations for rabies pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) for travellers at risk of exposure to rabid animals or with difficulty obtaining safe post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), with an exposure period of ≦3 years, are as follows:

lines.t: 免疫力正常者接種2劑次(接種時程為第0、7天)。
lines.e: People with normal immunity: 2 doses (schedule: days 0 and 7).

lines.t: 免疫力低下者接種3劑次(接種時程為第0、7、21或28天)。
lines.e: People with weakened immunity: 3 doses (schedule: days 0, 7, and 21 or 28).

lines.t: 建議旅客至少提早1個月至旅醫門診諮詢，並請醫師評估是否需要接種暴露前疫苗。
lines.e: Travellers are recommended to consult a travel medicine clinic at least 1 month in advance and to have the doctor assess whether pre-exposure vaccination is needed.

lines.t: 幼兒較容易受到動物攻擊，若預計在當地長期停留，且當地犬、貓有狂犬病疫情，可考慮先接種3劑狂犬病疫苗。
lines.e: Young children are more easily attacked by animals. If they plan to stay there long-term and dogs and cats there have rabies outbreaks, you may consider giving 3 doses of rabies vaccine first.

vaccines.name: 麻疹、腮腺炎及德國麻疹混合(MMR)疫苗

lines.t: 預防麻疹與德國麻疹最有效的方式為接種MMR疫苗，目前國內提供滿1歲及滿5歲的幼兒各一劑公費MMR疫苗;15歲到49歲的育齡婦女若經檢測為德國麻疹抗體陰性，可檢具德國麻疹抗體陰性報告，至各縣市衛生所或預防接種合約院所接種一劑公費MMR疫苗；其他民眾如為1966年(含)以後出生之成人且計劃前往流行地區，建議先洽旅遊醫學門診或國內提供自費MMR疫苗之醫療院所，評估接種一劑MMR疫苗。
lines.e: The most effective way to prevent measles and rubella is the MMR vaccine. Taiwan currently provides one publicly funded dose of MMR vaccine to children at age 1 and age 5. Women aged 15 to 49 of childbearing age who test negative for rubella antibodies can show the negative rubella antibody report and receive one publicly funded dose of MMR vaccine at a local health centre or a contracted vaccination clinic. Other people who are adults born in 1966 or later and plan to go to an affected area are recommended to first contact a travel medicine clinic or a medical institution in Taiwan that offers self-paid MMR vaccine, to be assessed for one dose of MMR vaccine.

lines.t: 孕婦及未滿1歲的嬰幼兒是感染高危險群，應避免前往流行地區；如必須前往,6個月以上未滿1歲的嬰幼兒可於出發2週以前自費接種一劑MMR疫苗。
lines.e: Pregnant women and infants and young children under 1 year are at high risk of infection and should avoid travelling to affected areas. If they must go, infants and young children aged 6 months or more but under 1 year can have one dose of MMR vaccine at their own expense at least 2 weeks before departure.

lines.t: 孕婦不可接種MMR疫苗，如須前往流行地區，出發前請先與醫師諮詢確認有無德國麻疹抗體及是否適合前往，在當地務必戴口罩、勤洗手，以降低感染風險。
lines.e: Pregnant women must not have the MMR vaccine. If a pregnant woman must travel to an affected area, before departure she should consult a doctor to confirm whether she has rubella antibodies and whether it is suitable for her to go. While there, be sure to wear a mask and wash your hands often to lower the risk of infection.

lines.t: 行程中會前往較偏僻或衛生條件較差地區的旅客(如探親、志工活動、背包客)，請告知醫師相關行程，並請醫師評估接種疫苗的需求。
lines.e: Travellers whose trip takes them to remote areas or areas with poorer hygiene (such as those visiting relatives, doing volunteer work or backpacking) should tell the doctor about the itinerary and ask the doctor to assess whether vaccination is needed.

lines.t: 2歲以下嬰幼兒目前沒有足夠的安全性、疫苗有效性資料，不適合接種傷寒疫苗。
lines.e: There are currently not enough data on safety and vaccine effectiveness for infants and young children under 2 years, so the typhoid vaccine is not suitable for them.

lines.t: 孕婦沒有足夠的接種試驗資料，雖然不活化疫苗對胎兒理論上沒有影響，仍應由醫師評估，有接種必要性才建議施打。
lines.e: There are not enough vaccination trial data for pregnant women. Although an inactivated vaccine should in theory have no effect on the baby, a doctor should still assess it, and vaccination is recommended only if necessary.

lines.t: 國內現用的傷寒疫苗是注射式的「多醣類不活化疫苗」，也就是「死菌疫苗」，免疫不全者可和一般旅客一樣評估接種。
lines.e: The typhoid vaccine now used in Taiwan is an injectable "polysaccharide inactivated vaccine", that is, a "killed vaccine", and people with weakened immunity can be assessed for vaccination in the same way as other travellers.
